description: In a document that keeps the `development` pack, before handing units out: for unit refs (every ready unit if left out), which can run at once and which share a path in their `paths` — one per line — and so go one after another, beside any unit in progress; a unit with no paths is unknown, never safe. Then each one’s brief, the units it waits on and the decisions it names. Read-only.
